# Card2Leads

> Card2Leads is a business card scanner and contact management application from
> BrillBrains Consultants Pvt. Ltd. It converts photographed or uploaded business
> cards into structured contact records that can be reviewed, labelled, exported
> as Excel, CSV or VCF, and optionally synced to Google Contacts and Google Sheets.
> It runs as a web app and as an Android app on Google Play.

## What it does

- Scans a business card with the phone camera, or accepts single and bulk image uploads.
- Extracts name, phone number, email address, company and designation from each card.
- Shows every extracted field for human review and correction before the record is saved.
- Adds labels, notes and voice notes to organise leads.
- Exports approved contacts as Excel, CSV or VCF files.
- Optionally writes selected contacts to Google Contacts, or creates and updates rows in Google Sheets.

## Platforms

- Web: https://card2leads.brillbrainsconsultants.com/
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.brillbrainsconsultants.card2leads
- Android package name: com.brillbrainsconsultants.card2leads

## Pricing

- 499 INR - one month, 150 card scans
- 799 INR - three months, 300 card scans
- 2,999 INR - one year, 1,500 card scans

## Data handling

- Card photographs and voice recordings are deleted 90 days after the card is created.
- Extracted contact details and voice note transcripts are kept for as long as the user keeps the record.
- Connecting a Google account is optional and is requested only when a feature needs it.
